reason: Packing morning school and office tiffins without oil or watery chutney leaking everywhere is worth ₹179 any day. If the squeeze tube really eliminates messy spoons and stained lunch bags, it becomes a permanent staple in my pantry.
objection: I worry the emulsion might separate inside the tube and squirt out clear water onto the first thepla.
would_change_my_mind: If the nozzle clogs or watery fluid squirts out on the first use, I will cancel and never repurchase.
